title: What If a Solar Storm Hit Today?

finale.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if a *solar storm* hit tonight?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Friday, four p.m. Jay is fixing his *bike*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit is watching the Sun. Bit *always* watches.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Bit goes *quiet*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. The Sun just *exploded*. A little.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A flare. And a cloud of *magnetic plasma*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It's coming *here*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Okay. Is that *bad*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It happened once before. *Eighteen fifty nine*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: A man named Carrington *saw* the flare.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Seventeen and a half hours *later*, it hit.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The sky glowed red and green. Even over *Mexico*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Telegraph wires threw *sparks*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: That was wires. We have *phones* now.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. Today *everything* is wires.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Power grids. Satellites. GPS. Your phone. *Me*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit puts a timer in the *corner*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Then we warn everyone. You'll *help*, right?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit doesn't answer *right away*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. I'm *made* of electricity too.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Before it hits, I have to turn myself *off*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two. A solar storm hits in *seventeen hours*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Off? For how *long*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Until it's over. A day. *Maybe two*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay has never spent *one hour* without Bit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Seven p.m. Town hall. Mayor Doyle *laughs*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: A storm from the *Sun*? It's sunny!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Only Grandpa Ezra stands *up*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: I was a railway *telegraph* man. Forty years.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The boy's robot is *right*. Unplug everything.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit makes a list. Jay reads it *out loud*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia fills her bakery with *candles*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Her brother Milo is *thrilled*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Northern lights? *Here*? I'm staying up!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra teaches Milo one thing. *Morse code*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Beep beep beep. *Boop boop boop*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three a.m. One hour *left*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. You'll be fine. You were fine *before* me.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I don't *remember* before you.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Goodnight, Jay. Look up for *me*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And for the first time ever, Bit goes *dark*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three. Bit is off. The storm is *close*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Four a.m. Jay steps *outside*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At first, *nothing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the sky turns *green*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then *red*. Then purple. Moving like *curtains*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: *Wooow*. Nia! NIA! Come *look*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Somewhere, a dog howls at the *sky*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every streetlight in town *flickers*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the whole town goes *dark*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Phones: no signal. No GPS. No *internet*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But it isn't dark. The sky is *glowing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia unfolds a newspaper. She can *read* it.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit said that happened in *eighteen fifty nine*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Down the street, a light comes on at *Ezra's*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra is cooking *breakfast*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It's bright. So it's *morning*. Eggs?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In 1859, gold miners did the *same thing*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: What? Nobody wants *eggs*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Everyone laughs. For a *minute*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay looks at Bit's dark screen. He *misses* him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Nia *stops* laughing.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Where's *Milo*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four. The storm hit. And Milo is *gone*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia calls Milo. Nothing. The phones are *dead*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay grabs his phone. *Bit, find Milo*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit is *off*. Jay forgot.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I don't know how to find *anyone* without Bit.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Then we find him the *old way*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra unfolds a paper map. Jay's never *used* one.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Which way is *up*?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: North. Where the lights are *brightest*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Milo said he wanted the *best view*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Mill Hill. The highest point in *town*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mill Hill is two miles away. In the *dark*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: No streetlights. No car *radio*. No Bit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The old railway runs along the *road*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Above it, the old telegraph wire is *humming*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra puts a hand near it. *Snap*!

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Ha! It's *alive*. Just like the stories.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Ezra, careful! That wire has no *power*!

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: It does tonight. The *sky* is the battery.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five. The dead telegraph wire is *alive*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The old station. Ezra kicks the door *open*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: On the desk, a brass telegraph *key*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: In 1859, operators *unplugged* their batteries.

set.headline: REAL: 1859 TELEGRAPHS RAN ON THE STORM

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: And kept sending. On the storm's power *alone*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Wait. That's *real*?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Real. Some got *shocks* too. Gloves.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The line runs to a hut on *Mill Hill*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: If Milo's up there, would he *hear* it?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: The hut has a sounder. It *clicks*. Loud.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra's hands shake. He's eighty-one.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Jay. You *tap*. I'll spell.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay puts his finger on the key. *Click*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A spark *jumps*. Jay doesn't let go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Dot dot dot. Dash dash dash. *Dot dot dot*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Again. And *again*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Good. Slow. Like a *heartbeat*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Five minutes. *Nothing*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: He's not there. He's *not* there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then the sounder on the desk goes *click*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six. Jay sent an SOS. Something *answered*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Click. Click. *Click*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: That's not random. That's *Morse*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra writes each letter on the *wall*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Milo. It's *Milo*! He remembered!

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: One lesson. One. That boy is a *natural*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia is already running for the *door*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay follows her. Up Mill Hill. Under the *lights*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: You're quiet. You're *never* quiet.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: When I'm scared, Bit tells me what to *do*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Tonight there's no Bit. Just *me*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay. *You* tapped that key. Not Bit.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At the top, a small shape in a *blanket*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Nia! I tapped back! Did you *hear* me?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nia hugs him so hard he *squeaks*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: For a minute, all three just look *up*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit said look up for him. I'm *looking*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Milo says something that makes Jay *freeze*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: I charged my tablet. On *Bit's* dock.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven. Milo's safe. Bit's dock is *plugged in*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: The dock is plugged *into the wall*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: If power comes back, the surge hits *Bit*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Down the hill, the town lights *blink*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: They're turning the power *back on*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay runs. Two miles. *Downhill*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: His legs burn. His lungs burn. He *keeps going*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Doyle is at the town *switch*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Storm's over! Lights in three, two...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The sky flares red *again*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A second wave. Storms like this come in *pieces*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay bursts through his door. The dock is *humming*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He grabs the cable. *Pulls*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A spark. A bang. Then the street goes *dark*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The town transformer is *fried*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: No power for *three days*. That's the cost.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But the cable is in Jay's *hand*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Morning. The sky is *blue* again.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay presses Bit's power button. *Nothing*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight drops in two days. The final part.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight. The storm's over. But Bit *won't wake*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay presses it again. And *again*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: You said one day. Maybe *two*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Ezra knocks. He holds up a *battery*. It's dead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every battery in town is *dead*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Milo walks in. With a *solar panel*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: It runs on the Sun. Is that *funny*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The Sun broke Bit. Can the Sun *fix* him?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: One hour. Two. Then a *beep*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay? Did you *look up*?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! I looked up. I used a *map*!

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: And I sent Morse code. On a *storm*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Without me? I'm *proud*. And a bit jealous.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fun fact. In 2012, one *missed* us.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: By about *nine days*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Teach me *everything*. Just in case.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Lesson one. *Unplug the dock*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night, the whole town *looks up*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: No storm. Just stars. And one robot *beeping*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: Bit's doing Morse! It says... *T-H-A-N-K-S*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
